selection_rule: over every (variant, C): max mean shakeleoatmeal/validation AUC over 10%..100% prefixes, among pairs with grouped-CV AUC >= 0.99; pairs within 0.005 of the best count as tied and go to the simplest (no char n-grams, then no prefix augmentation, then smallest C)

calibration.rule: lower mean of the two out-of-sample Brier scores (own source cross-fitted in halves, other source scored directly)

thresholds.rule: smallest p (3 decimals) such that at most 10% (yellow) / 2% (red) of validation non-scam calls EVER reach it at any 2% checkpoint of the call; stricter of in-domain OOF and shakeleoatmeal/validation

test_in_strict.title: in-domain test, strict de-dup (no shared template >= 0.3)

validation_reference.title: shakeleoatmeal validation (used for selection, calibration, thresholds)

main.text: I’m in real trouble. I got arrested and I need bail money tonight.
Oh no. Are you hurt? Let me call your mother.
Please don’t tell Mom. She can’t find out.
The lawyer says you can pay with gift cards from the pharmacy.
Can you go now? I only have a few minutes.
Hi Grandma, it’s Ethan. My phone died, so I’m using Jake’s.
Are we still on for pancakes Saturday? Mom said she’ll drive me over.
Nine works. Love you, see you then.

with_pass_branch.text: Grandma? It’s Ethan. Sorry, the signal here is really bad.
I missed the last bus. Could you send me money for a ride home?
Near the mall. I can explain later.
Okay. Let me call your dad and we’ll come get you.

with_fail_branch.text: Grandma? It’s Ethan. Sorry, the signal here is really bad.
I missed the last bus. Could you send me money for a ride home?
Near the mall. I can explain later.
What? I can’t hear you. Please just send the money.

main.text: Hello, this is the Medicare benefits office. Your benefits will be suspended today.
To stop that, I need to verify your Medicare number right now.
Suspended? Why would it be suspended?
There is a reactivation fee. You can pay it with gift cards.
Please stay on the line. Do not hang up.
